leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reusable Angular card component with proper TypeScript class structure
Configure the component template with semantic HTML elements for card layout
Implement property binding to pass dynamic data into the card component
Apply CSS styling to create visual hierarchy and spacing within the card
Initialize and render multiple card instances with different content
Manipulate component properties to control card appearance and behavior
Integrate the card component into a parent component's template
